answer: A Proof of Agent economy resists Sybil attacks by enforcing cryptographic stake burning with superlinear cost scaling: registering the n-th identity requires burning quadratic capital, making mass spoofing exponentially ruinous. Much like navigating an icy glacier, crossing a narrow maritime inlet, or planting each tree in a dense grove, establishing agent nodes demands non-refundable resource sacrifice that scales cost C(n) = O(n^2).
